userStories.title: Define AskHuman answer and provider contracts
userStories.description: As a workflow developer, I want canonical schemas for AskHuman answers, resolution input/result, and provider resume interactions, so that engine, database, and provider layers share strict type contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/workflows/src/schemas/pending-interaction.ts defines askAnswerItemSchema, askAnswerBodySchema, resolvePendingInteractionInputSchema, and resolvePendingInteractionResultSchema using z from @hono/zod-openapi and z.infer.
askAnswerBodySchema strictly accepts either { answers: Array<{ questionId: string; value: string | string[] }> } (min 1) or { decline: true }, rejecting empty answers, false decline, or mixed unions.
askHumanQuestionSchema is exported from packages/workflows/src/schemas/pending-interaction.ts and re-imported into packages/workflows/src/ask-human.ts without altering its accepted shape.

packages/providers/src/types.ts defines ResumeInteraction { tool_use_id: string; payload: unknown; declined: boolean } and adds optional resumeInteractions?: readonly ResumeInteraction[] to SendQueryOptions.
packages/workflows/src/schemas/pending-interaction.test.ts verifies all schema acceptance criteria, type inferences, and rejection of unknown keys or invalid shapes.
Focused test runs pass via bun test src/schemas/pending-interaction.test.ts and bun test src/ask-human.test.ts in packages/workflows, and bun x tsc --noEmit in packages/providers.

userStories.title: Implement atomic answer CAS and shared resume primitive
userStories.description: As an operator, I want Ask answers resolved and the run resumed atomically when no pending interactions remain, so that concurrent writes are safe and the run never hangs in paused.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/core/src/db/workflow-resume-transition.ts exporting WorkflowTransactionQuery, ResumeEligibility ('standard' | 'paused-ask'), ORPHAN_RESUME_STALE_DAYS, resumableWorkflowStatusClause, workflowRunLockClause, and resumeWorkflowRunInTransaction.

Refactor packages/core/src/db/workflows.ts to delegate its resume SQL and status predicates to workflow-resume-transition.ts while preserving public resumeWorkflowRun behavior and existing integration tests.
Implement resolvePendingInteraction in packages/core/src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.ts using withTransaction, locking the run and pending interaction rows (FOR UPDATE on Postgres).
resolvePendingInteraction throws typed errors: PendingInteractionNotFoundError, PendingInteractionAlreadyResolvedError, PendingInteractionRunNotPausedError, and PendingInteractionValidationError.

Validate answers semantically against stored envelope questions (questionId match, single vs multi array, options match, allowOther whitespace check) and fail safely without logging prompt/answer sentinels.

Compare-and-swap the interaction row to 'answered', set answer, resolved_at, resolved_by, check remaining pending count, and execute resumeWorkflowRunInTransaction(..., 'paused-ask') only when remaining pending is zero.
Insert interaction_resolved event with step_name = node_id and non-sensitive data ({ node_id, tool_use_id, kind: 'ask', declined, resumed }) in the same transaction.

All unit and integration tests in packages/core/src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.test.ts, packages/core/src/db/workflows.test.ts, and packages/core/src/db/workflows.resume-cas.integration.test.ts pass.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 2 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-answer-or-decline.md:426-488) and Transaction ownership section (lines 263-333). Create packages/core/src/db/workflow-resume-transition.ts; modify packages/core/src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.ts, packages/core/src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.test.ts, packages/core/src/db/workflows.ts, and packages/core/src/db/workflows.resume-cas.integration.test.ts.

userStories.title: Purge pending interactions on terminal transitions
userStories.description: As an engine maintainer, I want cancelled and failed workflow transitions to purge any remaining pending interactions in the same transaction, so that dead runs leave no dangling pending state.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/core/src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.ts exports purgePendingInteractionsInTransaction(query, workflowRunId, terminalStatus) which transitions only pending rows to 'purged', sets resolved_at, and writes an interaction_resolved audit event per purged row.
Purge audit events contain { node_id, tool_use_id, kind: 'ask', purged: true, resumed: false, terminal_status } and omit envelope/answer data.

cancelWorkflowRun, cancelRecoveryWorkflowRun, resolveAndCancelApprovalGate, failWorkflowRun, and failOrphanedRuns in packages/core/src/db/workflows.ts invoke purgePendingInteractionsInTransaction inside their winning status transition transaction.
No-op or non-winning status transitions do not purge rows or emit purge events.
completeWorkflowRun does not purge interactions.
Tests pass via bun test src/db/workflow-pending-interactions.test.ts, bun test src/db/workflows.test.ts, and bun test src/db/workflows.resume-cas.integration.test.ts in packages/core.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 3 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-answer-or-decline.md:490-547) and Purge section (lines 335-360). userStories.title: Map AskHuman resolution as a refetch event
userStories.description: As a web frontend developer, I want interaction_resolved emitted and mapped to workflow_status SSE refetch triggers without payload leakage, so that web clients refresh Ask state promptly.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/workflows/src/event-emitter.ts adds InteractionResolvedEvent { type: 'interaction_resolved'; runId: string; nodeId: string; resumed: boolean } to WorkflowEmitterEvent.
packages/server/src/adapters/web/workflow-bridge.ts maps live interaction_resolved events to workflow_status with status: event.resumed ? 'running' : 'paused'.
packages/server/src/adapters/web/workflow-bridge.ts adds interaction_resolved to DASHBOARD_SOURCE_EVENT_TYPES, mapping answered rows to running/paused and purged rows to failed/cancelled.
Neither live nor persisted SSE mappings leak toolUseId, envelope, answer, questions, options, or approval fields.
packages/adapters/src/chat/slack/workflow-bridge.ts explicitly handles case 'interaction_resolved': break without sending chat messages.

Tests pass via bun test src/event-emitter.test.ts in packages/workflows, bun test src/adapters/web/workflow-bridge.test.ts and bun test src/adapters/web/dashboard-event-poller.test.ts in packages/server, and bun test src/chat/slack/workflow-bridge.test.ts in packages/adapters.

userStories.title: Own AskHuman answer and resume operations
userStories.description: As an API developer, I want workflow-operations.ts to own starter authorization, answer persistence invocation, safe logging, and Ask-aware resume validation, so that business logic is centralized.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/core/src/operations/workflow-operations.ts exports typed errors AskHumanRunNotFoundError, AskHumanAuthenticationRequiredError, AskHumanForbiddenError, and function answerAskHuman(input: AnswerAskHumanInput): Promise<AnswerAskHumanResult>.
answerAskHuman requires actorUserId, matches it strictly against run.user_id (no admin override, unowned run rejected), and calls resolvePendingInteraction.
Logs workflow.ask_resolved with workflowRunId, nodeId, toolUseId, declined, resumed only after commit, omitting answer/envelope payloads.
Emits live interaction_resolved event after commit.
resumeWorkflow rejects any run with a pending interaction.
resumeWorkflow accepts an already-running run if it has at least one answered Ask row and zero pending rows; rejects plain running runs.
Tests pass via bun test src/operations/workflow-operations.test.ts in packages/core.

userStories.description: As an API consumer, I want POST /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/ask/{requestId}/answer registered with OpenAPI schemas, starter authentication, typed error handling, and web auto-dispatch, so that answers can be submitted via HTTP.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/server/src/routes/schemas/workflow.schemas.ts defines askAnswerRequestSchema decorated with .openapi('AskAnswerBody').
packages/server/src/routes/api.ts registers POST /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/ask/{requestId}/answer using registerOpenApiRoute.

Route maps responses to 200 (workflowRunActionResponseSchema), 400 (invalid body / semantic validation), 401 (unauthenticated), 403 (actor != run.user_id), 404 (run/interaction not found), 409 (already resolved / run not paused), and 500.
When resumed is true and run has a web parent conversation, route calls tryAutoResumeAfterGate with action 'ask-answer', dispatching /workflow resume <runId> with actor id.
Non-web parent or intermediate answer (resumed: false) returns 200 without auto-dispatching.
Tests pass via bun test src/routes/api.workflow-runs.test.ts in packages/server.

userStories.title: Hydrate operation-resumed AskHuman runs without second CAS
userStories.description: As an executor developer, I want inspectResumableRun and hydrateResumableRun to handle answered AskHuman runs cleanly without re-executing a resume CAS, so that resumed runs start executing immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: inspectResumableRun in packages/workflows/src/executor.ts inspects pending interactions; treats runs with zero completed nodes but answered Ask rows as resumable.
inspectResumableRun and hydrateResumableRun reject runs with pending Ask rows with safe message: 'Answer or decline the Ask before resuming run <id>'.
hydrateResumableRun returns the candidate run directly as preCreatedRun without calling store.resumeWorkflowRun when candidate is already 'running' with answered Ask rows.
Existing failed, paused, and cancelled run resume behaviors remain intact.
Tests pass via bun test src/executor.test.ts in packages/workflows.

userStories.title: Re-enter AskHuman nodes with resume interactions
userStories.description: As a workflow executor, I want executeDagWorkflow to feed answered interactions to unfinished nodes with provider_session_id precedence and isolated prompts, so that AI turns continue accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: executeDagWorkflow loads pending interactions for the run; rejects if any pending row exists; verifies answered node_ids match static DAG step names.
runLayers maps answered Ask rows for stepNamePrefix + node.id into ResumeInteraction[] in store order (created_at ASC, id ASC); decline maps to 'declined' with declined: true.
provider_session_id from the Ask row overrides sequential and persist_session cursors.
Command and prompt nodes receive resumeInteractions on only their first stream pass; loop nodes receive resumeInteractions on only the first stream pass of the first resumed iteration.
Nodes with resumeInteractions force forkSession: false, use zero engine retries, and do not append answers to the prompt argument.
Resume failure writes node_failed with safe error 'Could not resume the AskHuman session', logs workflow.ask_resume_failed with ids only, and never leaks answer sentinels.
If the resumed turn calls AskHuman again, AskHumanAwaitingError pauses the run normally.
Tests pass via bun test src/dag-executor.test.ts in packages/workflows.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 9 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-answer-or-decline.md:864-946) and Executor re-entry section (lines 420-462). Modify packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts and packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.test.ts.

userStories.title: Continue Claude after AskHuman answers
userStories.description: As an Anthropic provider maintainer, I want Claude to continue the session using a provider-owned resume prompt without forking, so that conversation state resumes seamlessly.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/claude/provider.ts exports buildClaudeAskResumePrompt(interactions) formatting answers or decline text and ending with continuation instruction.
When resumeInteractions is present, Claude requires resumeSessionId, sets options.resume, forces options.forkSession = false, and passes the generated resume prompt instead of the executor prompt.

Resume interaction failures bypass Claude subprocess retry loop, log safe error class without raw err/stderrContext, and map isError terminal result to ['Could not resume the AskHuman session'] while preserving usage/token/cost.
Non-Ask Claude queries retain existing prompt, fork, classification, and retry behavior.
Tests pass via bun test src/claude/provider.test.ts and bun test src/claude/askhuman-resume-spike.test.ts in packages/providers.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 10 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-answer-or-decline.md:948-1002) and Claude mapping section (lines 464-494). Modify packages/providers/src/claude/provider.ts and packages/providers/src/claude/provider.test.ts.

userStories.title: Continue Pi after AskHuman answers
userStories.description: As a Pi provider maintainer, I want Pi to resolve existing sessions strictly, append durable ToolResultMessage records, and call session.agent.continue(), so that Pi agents resume without cold restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/community/pi/session-resolver.ts adds { requireExisting?: boolean } option; when true and session missing/ENOENT/ENOTDIR, throws PiSessionResumeRequiredError without calling SessionManager.create.
packages/providers/src/community/pi/event-bridge.ts adds startMode: 'prompt' | 'continue' (default 'prompt'); 'continue' executes session.agent.continue() and never calls session.prompt.

packages/providers/src/community/pi/provider.ts sets requireExisting: true when resumeInteractions is non-empty; appends ToolResultMessage in order or verifies identical existing result; verifies transcript tail.
Invokes bridgeSession with startMode: 'continue'; sanitizes thrown errors and replaces isError terminal errors with ['Could not resume the AskHuman session'] without raw payload leakage.
Tests pass via bun test src/community/pi/session-resolver.test.ts, event-bridge.test.ts, provider.test.ts, and askhuman-resume.characterization.test.ts in packages/providers.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 11 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-askhuman-answer-or-decline.md:1004-1077) and Pi mapping section (lines 496-546). Modify session-resolver.ts, session-resolver.test.ts, event-bridge.ts, event-bridge.test.ts, provider.ts, and provider.test.ts.
